profileEvidence.summary: Lively, vocal and ready for action, the Pumi brings a terrier-like style to Hungarian herding work. Its standard describes boldness and some reserve toward strangers. The fawn form shares that working character with the other colors; the breed also has a documented scenting role in tackling rodents and larger animals.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A lively, vocal Hungarian herder; the fawn form shares the breed’s bold working character and scenting skills.
profileEvidence.author: L worker B

profileEvidence.summary: Happy, lively and even-tempered in its breed standard, the Pug is a companion dog whose appeal centers on its expressive character. Apricot is one of its recognized coat varieties, with no separate temperament assigned to the color. The breed’s history runs from China to Europe through Dutch traders, and later to England with William III.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A lively, even-tempered companion in the breed standard; apricot is a coat variety, with the same Pug character.
